email_note: Deep search performed per Fase 1 punto 7, no verifiable public email found: (1) Instagram web_profile_info business_email field is null (fetched successfully, field present but empty, account is not flagged as a business account); (2) Booksy JSON-LD and the full embedded Nuxt business payload were grepped for 'email'/'phone' keys, neither exists anywhere in the Booksy data for this business; (3) linktr.ee/Slaybytayx opened and scanned for an email pattern, none found (only booking/social/affiliate links); (4) Facebook About page (facebook.com/Kweentayhair/about) blocked by Facebook's login wall on both desktop and mbasic fetch attempts, could not be read; (5) a general web search surfaced an address 'kweentayhairtm@gmail.com' repeated across multiple AI-generated search-summary answers, but on inspection NONE of the actual underlying indexed pages/snippets returned by that search (Phenix Salon Suites page, Facebook, Booksy, Yelp for an unrelated same-named San Jose business, Instagram) contain that string anywhere in their real content; direct searches for the exact string 'kweentayhairtm' returned zero genuine matching pages (only Gmail-signup and unrelated results), and the Phenix Salon Suites professional page itself returned HTTP 403 on every direct fetch attempt (both curl and WebFetch) and has no Wayback Machine snapshot, so it could not be independently read to confirm or deny. Since this address cannot be traced to any actual retrievable source content, it is treated as UNVERIFIED and deliberately NOT used, per the hard rule against fabricated/unconfirmed data. Real contact channels are Booksy, Instagram DM, and phone/text at (727) 279-5225.

brand_vibe.description: Logo (assets/raw/logo.jpg) is an elegant feminine hair-silhouette line-drawing in a bronze-to-champagne gradient on a soft cream background, with 'SLAY BY TAY' in bold serif-caps and 'EXPERIENCE' in a thin gold tracked subtitle: reads as glam, confident, boutique. The actual suite interior (assets/raw/interior-suite.jpg, a real Booksy business photo) shows a pink/blue neon 'Slay Queen' sign with a heart, a gold-and-marble 'GIRL BOSS' wall panel, a warm camel velvet shell chair, a vintage-style hooded dryer, and a handwritten 'Follow Me' card: a bold, feminine, glam-boutique private-suite vibe (Phenix Salon Suites model), not a soft spa aesthetic. Most of the real finished-result photos are shot against a plain black backdrop or a black smock printed with red roses, giving the work itself a moody, editorial, salon-glam frame; several results are vivid fashion colors (platinum with pink/purple peekaboo, honey-blonde locs) alongside sleek jet-black silk presses. Instagram bio signs the stylist as a 'Matrix Artist/Educator', reinforcing a premium-editorial, color-forward positioning rather than a quiet/minimal one.

language_evidence: Instagram bio is entirely in English. All 4 real captions pulled from the feed (Blonde locs / Silk press / Two Strand Twists / From curls to sleek perfection) are in English. All 3 verbatim Booksy reviews are in English. Booksy category and service names are all English ('LOCS', 'COLOR', 'Retwist', etc). Clearwater, FL (Pinellas County) is a majority English-speaking market. Site built fully bilingual (EN default, ES toggle) per pipeline requirement regardless.

images_downloaded.sources: 11 images (logo, cover, 1 biz_photo, 8 inspiration) came from the Booksy business photo payload (images.logo/cover/bizPhoto/inspiration in the resolved Nuxt data) via cloudfront URLs, curl with Chrome UA. 12 images came from Instagram's own web_profile_info feed for @slaybytayexperience: expanded 4 real GraphSidecar posts actually authored by slaybytayexperience (owner.username filter applied, since edge_owner_to_timeline_media also returned several posts owned by a different tagged/collab account, 'chrispcreationseats', a food-truck business that is clearly NOT part of this hair salon and was excluded entirely) plus 1 non-carousel image that turned out to be a plain text graphic ('fully booked' announcement, not a photo, excluded from gallery use). All 23 files verified with `file` as valid JPEGs >15KB before use.
images_downloaded.curation_note: Visual curation performed image-by-image with the Read/vision tool, not by filename. Excluded from gallery entirely: the Booksy interior photo was kept for the About/experience section only (real suite ambiance, not a hair result); the IG 'fully booked' graphic (text/marble background, not a photo of hair or the business); one IG 'before' curly-texture shot (real but pre-styling, not a finished result, kept only as research context, not used on site); one full-head front-lean dread photo with a slightly busy background (K-cup rack, wine bottle visible) was also left out of the final gallery selection in favor of the cleaner side/back angles of the same style. Everything used on the live site shows an open-eyed, well-lit, finished styling result, or a genuine ambiance/interior shot used only in the About section; no owner selfies were available or used (no portrait of KaShawnte's own face was found in any source, so the About section uses the interior photo and the salon logo instead of a personal avatar).

research_note: Research conducted 2026-07-19. Identity, address, phone, rating/review count, hours, and full service menu cross-verified across two independent structured-data sources on the same live Booksy page (schema.org JSON-LD and the embedded Nuxt payload), which agreed on every overlapping field. Instagram web_profile_info API worked on the first attempt (no blocking encountered). No own domain found (5 domain variants tested, all non-resolving; Booksy's own website field is null). No public email found despite exhausting every source in the pipeline's checklist; a plausible-looking email surfaced repeatedly in web-search summaries could not be traced to any actual retrievable page content and was deliberately rejected as unverified rather than used. All service prices/durations and all 3 review quotes are verbatim from Booksy, nothing invented.
